name: Seungyeol Ryu
bio: At UNNEST, I help build AI agents that run on private networks. My research at Yonsei looks at how models learn from noisy data.

projects.name: AI assistance for local government administration
projects.summary: Managed development of an AI assistant that retrieves information for public-service workflows and asks follow-up questions to clarify requests.
projects.case_study: I managed the AI assistant prototype. I worked on the conversation flow so it could ask for missing details, retrieve the relevant public-service guidance, and use those sources to draft an answer.

visual.alt: The Solideo architecture diagram connecting the chat interface, guardrails, orchestrator, and agents for legal search, memory, and form handling.

projects.caption: Agent architecture from my PowerPoint portfolio.

projects.name: Metal contamination detection in battery cathode materials
projects.summary: Worked on models that use manufacturing process data to detect metal contamination.
projects.case_study: I examined production sensor readings and lab assays for metal contamination. I mapped how the two sources could be matched by production lot to prepare labeled examples for a detection model.

visual.alt: EcoPro BM workflow. Align process measurements by production lot, predict ICP measurements with virtual metrology, and assess metal contamination risk.

projects.caption: Virtual metrology workflow adapted from my PowerPoint portfolio, with the original EcoPro BM logo.

projects.name: Predicting steel plate curvature after rolling
projects.summary: Worked on image segmentation and contour analysis to predict upward or downward deformation in thick steel plates.
projects.case_study: I worked on selecting usable frames from rolling-line images, segmenting the plate, and extracting its lower edge. We used the outline to measure curvature and predict whether the plate tip would bend up or down in a later pass.

visual.alt: The steel plate analysis workflow with example frames for labeling, segmentation, contour extraction, and prediction.

projects.caption: Original pipeline figure from the POSCO project presentation in my portfolio.

projects.name: Care product recommendation system
projects.summary: Contributed to a system that recommends care products based on patient needs.
projects.case_study: As a research assistant, I contributed to a recommender that uses patient needs, the care setting, and product information to suggest suitable supplies. I am a co-inventor on the associated published patent application.

visual.alt: Care product workflow. Use the patient profile and care setting to match products and recommend suitable supplies.

projects.caption: Workflow based on Korean patent application 10-2023-0185772.

projects.name: Personalized information for patients and caregivers
projects.summary: Contributed to an information system for patients, guardians, and caregivers.
projects.case_study: I contributed to the caregiver–patient matching project as a research assistant. Our team designed a model that uses patient and caregiver profiles, location, and past satisfaction to suggest matches. I am a co-inventor on the resulting patent.

visual.alt: Caregiver matching workflow. Use profiles and location to identify candidates, predict satisfaction, and recommend suitable caregivers.

projects.caption: Workflow based on Korean patent 10-2635315.
